limitations: Synthetic capacity vectors are shared across all generated documents; no relevance or agent-quality inference.
The eight real vectors are frozen public SciFact data with no new provider calls; this is coverage qualification, not relevance evaluation.
Legacy and current plans examine different populations when history exhausts the old budget. Partial and complete latency numbers are not equivalent-work speed comparisons.
Uncontrolled workstation load and 20 samples do not establish a production latency guarantee.
Logical serialized byte counters exclude physical read amplification, integrity-index reads, lookahead and allocations.
Expired or transitively invalidated candidates can still consume the current-candidate budget.
Hybrid channel candidate caps remain unchanged, independently of full corpus coverage.
The first volume-backed baseline ran out of Docker disk space and was discarded; all reported successful series use fresh dedicated host directories.
